Provides Marketing Functional services under the general supervision of the Installation, DMWR, Marketing Manager.
Duties include determining marketing techniques and strategies to increase efficiency, enhance participation, and community awareness of all DMWR programs.
Conducts Media relations, commercial sponsorship and overall planning of special events.
Serves as representative to community and briefs media on programs and activities and their impact on civilian community.
Serves as the primary planner and action officer for a variety of recurring and special events, and activities that take place at the installation.
Resumes must be two pages (or less). Resumes should clearly demonstrate the applicant's relevant experience, skills, knowledge and abilities as they pertain to this position.

A qualified candidate must possess the following: Demonstrated related work experience that equipped the applicant with the particular knowledge, skills and abilities to perform successfully the duties of the position. Work experience must have been equivalent in complexity, difficulty and responsibility to the next lower pay band level.

IAW AR 215-3, paragraph 2-1, (1), (2), (3) and Appendix B.

In addition to the above qualifications, candidates who possess the following qualifications will be considered "Highly Preferred" or "Best Qualified": -Possess two (2) years of experience in a Department of Defense (DoD) marketing office, a DoD public affairs office or a similar private sector activity, with the ability to develop marketing strategies, sales campaigns, and plan and manage large special event marketing campaigns. -Possess one (1) year of experience managing various forms of social media (Facebook, X, YouTube, Instagram) to engage customers.

Applicant meeting the Best Qualifying Criteria/Highly Preferred will be referred to the hiring manager. All other qualified applicants will be referred if requested by the hiring manager. Claimed experience must be verifiable through your resume. Assumptions will not be made.

Bei TOOLPLACE GmbH digitalisierst Du gemeinsam mit uns die Angebots- und Beschaffungsprozesse in der Kunststoffspritzguss- und Werkzeugbau-Branche. Unsere B2B-Plattform vernetzt OEMs, Tier-1/Tier-2-Zulieferer, Spritzgießer und Werkzeugmacher und macht Anfragen, Angebote und Projekte transparenter und effizienter.
Damit mehr passende Unternehmen in der DACH-Region und international auf TOOLPLACE aufmerksam werden, schaffen wir eine neue Position: Als Online Marketing Manager in Teilzeit (ca. 50 %) übernimmst Du die Verantwortung für Performance Marketing und Content und baust unsere Lead-Generation-Maschine von Grund auf auf.
Aufgaben
Du planst, setzt auf und optimierst Performance-Kampagnen zur Leadgenerierung, vor allem über Google Ads und LinkedIn Ads, ergänzend auch über Meta (Facebook/Instagram), wo sinnvoll.
Du definierst klare Ziele (z. B. Demo-Anfragen, Qualifizierungs-Calls, Newsletter-Signups) und entwickelst passende Kampagnenstrukturen, Zielgruppen und Botschaften – auf Deutsch und Englisch.
Du baust unsere gesamte Paid- und Content-Marketing-Struktur schrittweise auf: Account-Setups, Tracking, Kampagnen-Frameworks, Reporting und wiederkehrende Routinen.
Du analysierst Kampagnenergebnisse (z. B. CPC, CTR, CPL, Leadqualität) und leitest konkrete Maßnahmen zur Verbesserung ab – von neuen Anzeigenvarianten bis zu Landingpage-Anpassungen.
Du stellst ein sauberes Tracking sicher (z. B. Google Analytics, Conversion-Tracking, UTM-Logik) und bereitest Kennzahlen für Entscheidungen im Team auf.
Du entwickelst und pflegst einen Redaktionsplan für LinkedIn – für das Unternehmensprofil und ausgewählte persönliche Profile (z. B. Geschäftsführung, Vertrieb).
Du bereitest Content vor, der unsere Zielgruppen im Werkzeugbau- und Spritzgussumfeld adressiert: Use Cases, Kundenbeispiele, Einblicke in Angebotsprozesse, Produkt-Updates, Marktbeobachtungen, bei Bedarf auch auf Englisch.
Du setzt AI-Tools gezielt ein (z. B. für Textentwürfe, Ad-Creatives, Keyword-Recherche, Auswertungen), um schneller Varianten zu testen und Kampagnen datenbasiert zu optimieren.
Du testest kontinuierlich neue Ansätze (Formate, Hooks, Zielgruppen, Landingpages) und entwickelst so unsere digitale Leadgenerierung weiter.
Du arbeitest eng mit Geschäftsführung und Vertrieb zusammen und bist zentraler Ansprechpartner für alle Themen rund um digitale Leads.
Qualifikation
Du hast 3–5 Jahre Erfahrung im Online- bzw. Performance-Marketing, idealerweise mit B2B-Fokus (z. B. SaaS, Tech oder Industrieumfeld).
Du kennst Dich sehr gut mit Google Ads aus und hast bereits eigenständig Such- und ggf. Display-Kampagnen zur Leadgenerierung verantwortet.
Du bringst praktische Erfahrung mit LinkedIn Ads / Campaign Manager mit und weißt, wie Du B2B-Zielgruppen auch international zielgerichtet ansprichst und testest.
Du bist sicher im Umgang mit Tracking- und Analyse-Tools (z. B. Google Analytics, Tag Manager, einfache Dashboards/Reports) und triffst Entscheidungen auf Basis von Zahlen.
Du hast Erfahrung mit LinkedIn-Content, von klaren Kurztexten bis hin zu Briefings für visuelle Formate (z. B. Karussells, einfache Creatives).
Du hast bereits aktiv mit AI-Tools gearbeitet (z. B. für Text- und Bildgenerierung, Recherchen oder Auswertungen) und nutzt diese bewusst im Marketing-Workflow.
Du arbeitest strukturiert, übernimmst gerne Ownership für “Dein” Thema und fühlst Dich wohl damit, einen Bereich eigenständig aufzubauen statt nur bestehende Setups zu betreuen.
Du kommunizierst sehr sicher auf Deutsch und Englisch in Wort und Schrift, insbesondere in Marketing- und Kampagnentexten.
Erfahrung mit Zielgruppen aus Maschinenbau, Automotive, Fertigung oder vergleichbaren Industrien ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss.
Der Umgang mit einfachen Design-Tools (z. B. Canva, Figma o. Ä.) ist wünschenswert, aber nicht zwingend erforderlich.

Eine neu geschaffene Position mit hoher Eigenverantwortung, in der Du den Bereich Performance Marketing und Leadgenerierung von Beginn an prägen und gestalten kannst.
Die Perspektive, Deinen Verantwortungsbereich mit unserem Wachstum auszubauen, bis hin zu höherem Pensum und der Übernahme von fachlicher oder disziplinarischer Führungsverantwortung, wenn das für Dich der passende nächste Schritt ist.
Direkten Einfluss auf Pipeline und Wachstum von TOOLPLACE, Deine Arbeit wirkt sich spürbar auf Anfragen und Projekte in der Kunststoffspritzguss- und Werkzeugbau-Branche aus.
Teilzeitmodell (ca. 50 %) mit planbaren Arbeitszeiten und der Möglichkeit, Arbeit und Privatleben gut zu verbinden.
Überwiegend Arbeiten vor Ort in Leipzig mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen und direktem Austausch mit Geschäftsführung, Vertrieb und Produktteam; Remote-Tage nach Absprache sind möglich.
Spricht Dich diese Aufgabe an und möchtest Du unsere Leadgenerierung im B2B-Industrieumfeld – national und international – von Grund auf mit aufbauen? Dann sende und gern Deinen Lebenslauf mit einigen Stichpunkten zu bisherigen Kampagnen und Ergebnissen.

In der Rolle des Online Marketing Managers (m/w/d) kalkulierst und steuerst du die Werbebudgets unserer Kunden. Ziel ist es die bestmögliche Sichtbarkeit mit einem vorgegebenen Budget zu erreichen. Um die Fortschritte der Arbeit auch dem Kunden zu übermitteln, werden regelmäßig Auswertungen erstellt. Auch die Positionierung der Produkte an gewünschten Werbeplätzen spielt hierbei eine große Rolle.🚀
Aufgaben
Strategieerarbeitung: Entwicklung von SEA-Strategien in enger Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Account Managern, um Werbepotenziale auf Amazon optimal auszuschöpfen und auszubauen.
Keyword-Recherche & SEO-Optimierung: Durchführung von Keyword-Recherchen sowie On- und Offpage-Analysen zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung der Kampagnenleistung.
Kampagnenoptimierung: Maximierung des Kampagnenpotenzials durch fortlaufende Optimierung und Überwachung der Kampagnen, um die bestmöglichen Ergebnisse zu erzielen.
Datenanalyse & Maßnahmenableitung: Analyse der Kampagnendaten mit Hilfe von Analyse-Tools und Ableitung konkreter Maßnahmen zur Verbesserung der Performance.
Reporting: Aufbau und Pflege von Reportings zur transparenten Dokumentation der Ergebnisse und Erfolge der Kampagnen für den Kunden.
Amazon Seller Central: Nutzung und Verwaltung des Amazon Seller Central zur Überwachung und Steuerung von Kampagnen.
PPC-Optimierung: Anpassung und Optimierung der PPC-Preise auf Basis zuvor festgelegter Strategien, um die Effizienz und den ROI der Werbemaßnahmen zu maximieren.
Qualifikation
Kaufmännische Ausbildung: Du hast eine abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung, idealerweise als Kaufmann/-frau für E-Commerce oder in einem ähnlichen Bereich.
Selbstständige Arbeitsweise: Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich und bist in der Lage, Aufgaben effizient und selbstständig zu bewältigen.
Schnelle Auffassungsgabe: Du hast die Fähigkeit, dich schnell in neue Themenfelder einzuarbeiten und komplexe Zusammenhänge zu verstehen.
Team- und Kommunikationsstärke: Du arbeitest gerne im Team und bist in der Lage, dich klar und präzise schriftlich sowie mündlich zu äußern.
Analytisches Denken: Ein ausgeprägtes Verständnis für Zahlen und die Fähigkeit, datenbasierte Entscheidungen zu treffen, zeichnen dich aus.
Strukturierte Kommunikation: Deine schriftliche und mündliche Kommunikation ist klar und gut organisiert.
Technisches Know-how: Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Excel und PowerPoint gehören zu deinem Repertoire, um Kampagnenanalysen und Präsentationen professionell zu erstellen.

Hybrides Arbeitsmodell: Kombination aus Home Office und Arbeit im Büro, für mehr Flexibilität und Teamgeist.
Weiterentwicklungs- und Aufstiegsmöglichkeiten: Zugang zu Schulungen und Workshops, um deine Fähigkeiten kontinuierlich auszubauen und deine Karriere innerhalb der Agentur voranzutreiben.
Teamkultur: Ein motiviertes, unterstützendes Team und eine offene Arbeitskultur.
Ausstattung : Moderne Arbeitsmittel und leistungsstarke Tools für deine täglichen Aufgaben.

Ich bin Ferdinand, habe in den letzten 10 Jahren 4 Unternehmen erfolgreich gegründet und dabei jedes Mal den Bereich Marketing & Growth verantwortet. Dabei habe ich viel richtig gemacht, einiges falsch, und vor allem eine Menge darüber gelernt, wie aus einem kleinen Startup ein gestandenes Unternehmen wird.
mieteinander ist meine neueste Gründung aus 2024. Den härtesten Weg - die ersten 2 Jahre seit dem Start bei Null- bin ich schon gegangen und weiß inzwischen, welche Kanäle bei uns funktionieren: Messen, Plattformintegrationen, Social Media, Webinare. Die nächste Phase ist jetzt die Skalierung dieser Kanäle. Dafür suche ich dich.
Wir würden eng zusammenarbeiten, und ich gebe gerne weiter, was ich in 10 Jahren gelernt habe. Was du hier vor allem bekommst, ist die Chance, etwas Eigenes entstehen zu sehen. Kampagnen, die du gebaut hast, Zahlen, die sich wegen dir bewegen und vor allem viele zwischenmenschliche Begegnungen- denn die Immobilienbranche ist ein People-Business.
Wer aus dem Marketing kommt, weiß, wie selten es ist, die eigenen Arbeitsergebnisse so klar zu sehen. Du bist kein kleines Rädchen in einem riesigen Uhrwerk, sondern sitzt selbst am Steuerhebel.
Was du mitbringen solltest: Lust, Dinge selbst anzupacken, ohne dass dir jemand jeden Schritt vorgibt. Wenn du das eher anstrengend findest, passen wir vermutlich nicht zusammen. Wenn es dich reizt, lies weiter.
Wir sind mieteinander – bundesweit spezialisiert auf die professionelle Optimierung von Mietverhältnissen in schlecht-vermieteten Wohnobjekten. Für Eigentümer holen wir aus bestehenden Beständen heraus, was möglich ist, ohne die Mieterseite zu vergessen. Unser Anspruch ist die faire Win-Win-Lösung: zufriedene Mieter, deutlich gesteigerte Objektwerte (im Schnitt 30–40 %) und ein Vergütungsmodell, das zu 100 % erfolgsbasiert ist.
Immer mehr Eigentümer geben ihre Objekte in unsere Hände, weil Mietverhandlungen Spezialwissen brauchen, das man sich intern nur schwer aufbaut. Wir übernehmen den kompletten Prozess – von der Potenzialanalyse über die Verhandlung bis zur digitalen Dokumentation.
Damit noch mehr Eigentümer von uns erfahren, suchen wir dich für unser Marketing in München.
Aufgaben
Du übernimmst nicht alles auf einmal. Wir starten mit den Kanälen, die schon laufen, und bauen Schritt für Schritt aus. Deine Schwerpunkte:
Events und Messen: Planung und Durchführung von rund drei Messen pro Jahr, von der Aussteller-Recherche über Berater-Briefings bis zur Koordinierung mit mir zusammen vor Ort.
Webinare: Eigene Webinare in festem Rhythmus aufsetzen und durchführen, inklusive Landing Page und Nachfass-Strecke. Dazu Partner-Webinare mit Finanzierungsvermittlern, Steuerberatern und Vermieter-Communities.
Partnernetzwerk und Tippgeber: Unser Netzwerk aus Steuerberatern, Finanzierungsvermittlern, Hausverwaltungen und Maklern ausbauen. Erstansprache, Onboarding und regelmäßiger Kontakt.
E-Mail-Marketing und Automation: Unseren Erfolgsfall-Newsletter in Newsletter-Tool betreuen und ausbauen, Segmentierung nach Lead-Status, automatisierte Nurture-Strecken (z. B. für Webinar-No-Shows).
Content und Sichtbarkeit: Referenzobjekte und Testimonials auf Website, Newsletter und Instagram ausspielen, unsere Instagram-Agentur steuern, Podcast-Gastauftritte und Fachartikel organisieren.
Reporting und Steuerung: Pipeline-Dashboard pflegen und die Kanäle monatlich über KPIs nachjustieren (Cost-per-Infogespräch, Lead-zu-Termin-Quote je Kanal).
Mittelfristig kommt ein größeres Projekt dazu: eine neue Tochtermarke von mieteinander aufbauen und launchen. Das ist Perspektive, kein Tag-eins-Auftrag.
Qualifikation
Berufserfahrung im Marketing, idealerweise B2B und gern in der Immobilien- oder Finanzbranche. Quereinstieg ist möglich, wenn der Rest passt.
Du arbeitest strukturiert und eigenständig und behältst mehrere Kanäle im Blick, ohne den Überblick zu verlieren. Du steuerst über KPIs, liest ein Dashboard und leitest daraus Entscheidungen ab, statt nach Bauchgefühl zu handeln.
Du arbeitest gern mit Menschen, ob am Messestand oder am Telefon mit potenziellen Multiplikatoren. Ein freundliches, verbindliches Auftreten gegenüber Partnern und Beratern gehört für dich dazu.
Erfahrung mit E-Mail-Marketing und gängigen Tools (MailerLite oder vergleichbar, CRM/HubSpot, Landing Pages, Social Media) ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss.

Du baust das operative Marketing mit auf und siehst direkt, was deine Arbeit bewirkt. Kurze Wege, direkte Zusammenarbeit mit der Geschäftsführung, schnelle Entscheidungen.
Gehalt : 50.000 bis 70.000 € je nach Erfahrung und ein leistungsbezogener Anteil, der mit unserem Wachstum mitzieht. Wir planen in Stufen und passen an, wenn die Zahlen stimmen.
Arbeitsweise : Flexible Arbeitszeiten, überwiegend Remote, da unser Team über Deutschland verteilt ist. Rund einen Tag pro Woche arbeitest du gemeinsame mit mir, einem der Gründer und CMO, in München, dazu mehrmals im Jahr Reisetätigkeit zu Messen und Beratertagen. Ein guter Mix aus Homeoffice, vor Ort und gemeinsamen Terminen.
Klingt nach dir? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung – ein kurzes Anschreiben und dein Lebenslauf reichen uns. Wenn du Beispiele aus deinem bisherigen Marketing zeigen kannst, umso besser. Bei Fragen vorab kannst du dich jederzeit bei uns melden. Wir melden uns zeitnah zurück.

PLEASE SUBMIT YOUR RESUME AND AUDIO RECORDING IN ENGLISH JOB TITLE Marketing Specialist JOB ID GRASAM1 INDUSTRY Real Estate Brokerage LOCATION LATAM preferred / PH / South Africa / Egypt JOB STATUS Full Time WORK SCHEDULE Monday to Friday, Highly flexible and deliverable-focused, with expected coverage/availability within the client's time zone (EST) as needed.

Key Requirement: Must be available every other Monday at 12:00 PM EST for the bi-weekly marketing team call. SALARY $10 - $12 per hour TARGET START DATE ASAP ROLE OVERVIEW About the Client: Our client is a premier, boutique real estate brokerage based in the vibrant market of Charlottesville, Virginia.

Known for exceptional client service and strong local expertise, the brokerage prides itself on high-quality presentation, community connection, and maintaining a polished, consistent brand image across the American real estate market.

About the Role: They are seeking a highly skilled and proactive Marketing Specialist to work directly with the Marketing Director, to manage, execute, and elevate their marketing initiatives. A primary focus of this position is to seamlessly take over day-to-day marketing operations.

They are looking for an autonomous, creative professional with advanced marketing skills who can take projects entirely across the finish line—from initial content creation all the way to paid ad execution and funding.

Key Responsibilities As the Marketing Specialist, you will handle full-cycle marketing campaigns and ensure brand consistency across all channels. Your main duties will include: Content Creation & Social Media: Design and manage engaging content across social media platforms, keeping our audience connected and growing.

Property & Listing Marketing: Develop and execute comprehensive marketing and promotional campaigns for new real estate listings. Ad Strategy & Execution: Build, fund, and manage paid advertising campaigns (e.g., Facebook Ads, Google Ads) from concept to conversion.

Print & Digital Design: Create high-quality print advertisements, flyers, and digital assets while strictly adhering to visual guidelines and brand consistency. SEO Optimization: Implement SEO strategies to improve search visibility and drive organic traffic.

Collaboration & Project Management: Coordinate closely with the Marketing Director on upcoming content needs, listing details, and campaign timelines to ensure a smooth transition.

Local Market Research: Proactively research and familiarize yourself with the Central Virginia (specifically Charlottesville) area to generate relevant local content, spotlight local businesses, and align campaigns with the community's culture.

Working in close partnership with both marketing and sales you will lead the strategic development and execution of all key account campaigns including social media channels, with a strategy that amplifies complementary campaigns and further leverages marketing and PR collateral to attract leads for sales, whilst also using PR tactics to amplify proprietary data and research findings.

The Campaign Marketing Manager will also act as a brand ‘gatekeeper’, ensuring that brand guidelines are followed in all external-facing communication..

s.h: Sales Enablement, Demand Generation and Collaboration
s.t:
Educate and inform the sales team through regular attendance at forecasting meetings, providing insights into campaign performance, lead generation, and customer engagement.
Foster a collaborative working relationship between marketing and sales teams, facilitating alignment on goals, strategies, and tactics.
Work closely with sales stakeholders to develop account-based marketing plans aimed at achieving their targets, and generate high quality leads.

Lead the strategic development and execution of key account campaigns in collaboration with sales stakeholders, ensuring alignment with sales targets and objectives.
Develop comprehensive account-based marketing plans to drive engagement and conversions within target accounts.
Develop and execute strategies to deliver key performance indicators (KPIs), optimising campaign performance across all channels.
Utilise analytical reporting to evaluate campaign effectiveness and inform ongoing and future activities.
Conduct monthly marketing reviews to track campaign productivity and iterate existing campaigns for continuous improvement.

s.h: CRM Marketing Automation and Content Creation
s.t:
Take a lead role in CRM marketing automation and daily execution, setting strategy and creating compelling content to nurture leads and drive conversions.
Collaborate with internal teams to ensure seamless integration of CRM initiatives with overall marketing campaigns and sales efforts.
Oversee the development of compelling campaign creative assets, ensuring alignment with brand guidelines, messaging, and audience preferences.

Design, plan, and execute complementary social media campaigns to amplify marketing collateral and increase brand visibility.
Develop strategies to leverage social media channels effectively, engaging target audiences and driving traffic to key campaign assets.

Drive growth across all M3 market research companies by developing comprehensive marketing campaigns that support their objectives and integrate seamlessly with existing initiatives.
Control and measure resources available for specific initiatives, allocating and prioritising resources to maximise return on investment (ROI).

Experience of working in HubSpot / other CRM platforms with the ability to pivot to Hubspot

You are the first person at Atira whose full-time job is brand and marketing. You will define how Atira presents itself to the public, both from a strategic and operational perspective.

The role sits at the heart of our GTM team with our BDR, AE, and GTM Engineer, and you work across every department: sales needs decks and stories, engineering needs a tech blog, product needs launches told in buyer language, recruiting needs an employer brand. You are the connective tissue that makes all of it look and sound like one company.

You will shape how Atira presents itself to the public, across every medium: text, visuals, web, fairs, and events. Concretely:
Build the messaging foundation. Together with the founders, constantly refine who Atira is for, what we claim, and why we win
Own the visual identity. Consistent design across website, decks, product touchpoints, and events. You own the design system and the rules it is built upon
Make Atira visible. LinkedIn presence, customer stories, industry fairs and events. The goal is measurable: inbound interest and recognition among our target buyers and recruiting prospects
Grow into product marketing. Once the foundation stands, translate product capability into buyer language: launch narratives, one-pagers, demo storylines, side by side with our engineers and FDEs

Creativity, hunger, structure, and the kind of taste that makes Atira iconic. We care more about who you are than about your CV. We have hired strong people from non-traditional backgrounds before and will confidently do it again.

s.h: That said, here is what we typically see in strong candidates
s.t:
Trained in a high-performing environment. 2+ years as part of a larger marketing or brand team, or under a strong marketing lead, at a startup, scaleup, or agency. You learned the craft from experienced people before owning it alone
Ownership evidence. You have owned a brand-shaped project end to end: rebuilt a startup's messaging and deck, ran a rebrand or website relaunch, or built a founder's LinkedIn presence to real reach
Craft. Your portfolio shows crisp writing and strong visual judgment. At Atira we highly value people who have clear opinions and are not afraid to share them!
Complex B2B exposure. Experience with, or demonstrated affinity for, technical or industrial B2B. You can talk to engineers and buyers without losing them
Self-directed. Comfortable owning the function alone, setting your own priorities, and shipping without a team
German + English. Fluent German for DACH industrial buyers and events, excellent English for global content
What you'll get
Real ownership. You are the first brand hire and build the function from zero. The brand Atira carries into the next hundred hires is the one you built
Direct line to the founders. You work hands-on with them on positioning and turn founder knowledge into public presence
Validated traction to work with. Leading industrial customers, several with revenues above €1B, and real stories waiting to be told
A rebrand to build on. Fully redesigned branding guidelines from our recently completed rebranding exercise with a top-tier brand agency, ready for you to roll out and evolve
Competitive salary & equity package and additional benefits including Wellpass, JobRad and company dinners.
Most importantly: Collaborate & thrive in a high-performing but caring culture. We will own the industrial sales function but will do so with modesty and integrity.
What success looks like after a few months
Atira has a positioning and messaging foundation adopted company-wide, a deck and template system every team actually uses, and a refreshed look that reflects it
Target buyers recognize us: growing LinkedIn engagement from ICP accounts, 2-3 published customer stories, presence at a key industry event, and the first inbound leads traceable to your work
The content engine runs without founder prompting, and brand requests from sales and recruiting get handled with fast turnaround

konfetti ist die Buchungsplattform und Software für lokale Workshops. Seit der Gründung im April 2021 haben wir unser Produkt stetig weiterentwickelt und arbeiten nun mit mehr als 2.500 Anbietern zusammen. Insgesamt können wir über 12.000 Erlebnissen und Aktivitäten in Deutschland, Österreich und online anbieten.
Dein next Step - konfetti!
Du suchst nach einer neuen Herausforderung in einem wachsenden Startup? Du möchtest Verantwortung für den Erfolg unseres Unternehmens übernehmen und beim weiteren Unternehmensaufbau aktiv mit anpacken?
Werde Teil eines Weltklasse-Teams mit office-first culture!
Aufgaben
Brand Marketing: Du entwickelst unsere Marke konsequent weiter und sorgst dafür, dass konfetti überall on brand erscheint - in Tonalität, Design und Wirkung. Wenn Leute konfetti hören, sollen sie sofort an Spaß, Qualität und unvergessliche Erlebnisse denken
Paid Social & Ad Creation: Du konzipierst, erstellst und steuerst performante Ads für Instagram, TikTok und Meta - vom ersten Hook bis zur finalen Conversion. Du testest datengetrieben, optimierst kontinuierlich und skalierst, was funktioniert
Partnerships & Barter Deals: Du identifizierst spannende Brands, die zu uns passen, baust langfristige Kooperationen auf und schließt kreative Barter Deals ab - Sichtbarkeit gegen Mehrwert, immer mit Win-Win-Ansatz
CRM & Newsletter: Du planst und versendest Newsletter, die Vorfreude wecken statt im Spam zu landen. Du segmentierst Zielgruppen, testest Betreffzeilen und steigerst Open- und Click-Rates systematisch
Content & Creative Production: Du produzierst eigenständig Visuals, Reels und Ad-Creatives mit Canva, Adobe oder vergleichbaren Tools - schnell, on brand und mit Gespür für aktuelle Trends
Performance Tracking: Du misst, was Du tust - von Ad-Performance über Newsletter-KPIs bis zur Partnership-Reichweite - und leitest daraus konkrete nächste Schritte ab
Qualifikation
Du bringst mindestens 2 Jahre Erfahrung im Marketing mit - idealerweise mit Schwerpunkt Brand, Paid Social, Performance Marketing oder Partnerships
Du hast nachweisbare Erfolge im Aufbau und in der Skalierung von Paid Social Kampagnen (Instagram, TikTok, Meta)
Du hast ein starkes Auge für Design und Content - Canva, Adobe Creative Suite oder vergleichbare Tools sind für Dich tägliche Werkzeuge
Du denkst datengetrieben: Du verstehst Performance-Metriken, leitest Hypothesen ab und testest sie strukturiert
Du bringst ausgeprägtes Interesse an KI und LLMs mit und nutzt diese Tools aktiv, um schneller und besser zu arbeiten
Du liebst es, mit Menschen zu sprechen, Kooperationen zu schmieden und Deals abzuschließen
Du bist Organisationstalent mit Hands-on-Mentalität - Du wartest nicht auf Briefings, sondern siehst selbst, was zu tun ist
Du sprichst Deutsch auf C2-Niveau und Englisch sicher

Attraktives Festgehalt

Deputy is a global SaaS workforce management company with hubs in Sydney, Melbourne, San Francisco and London, plus team members working remotely across the United States. Our platform serves over 1.5 million workers and 375,000 workplaces across 100+ countries. We are backed by top global investors and recently achieved Unicorn status.

At Deputy , we’re improving the world of work, one shift at a time, for 80% of the world’s workforce: hourly workers. These are the dedicated employees who keep our world running – from baristas to nurses, cleaners to delivery drivers, florists to factory workers.

Despite their vital role in society, most workplace technology has focused on those workers who sit behind a desk, but at Deputy , we transform the frontline. When businesses use Deputy , their workplaces thrive – the business is more profitable, compliant, and productive, while the workers are more engaged and happier at work.

We're becoming an AI-native company, a commitment that means you'll be empowered (and expected) to use AI tools and thinking in your day-to-day work. You'll have the training, support, and freedom to use AI responsibly and creatively to spark ideas, solve problems faster, and unlock new ways of working.

If you’re passionate about creating solutions that put people first and helping businesses and their teams thrive, join us at Deputy and make an impact where it matters most! The Role
Deputy is searching for a Senior Regional Marketing Manager to play a key role in our marketing organization. This person will develop and execute region-specific demand generation & growth plans to create qualified pipeline, and accelerate revenue growth across email, paid channels, content, industry events, and branded activations. This is a highly cross-functional role that partners closely with Sales, product marketing and other in-house teams across Marketing.
The ideal candidate is a strategic, hands-on marketer who can build the plan, rally the right teams, execute with excellence, and optimize quickly. They bring deep B2B/SaaS marketing expertise with a focus on SMB, strong project management skills, and a test-and-learn mindset. They are comfortable owning programs end to end, managing budgets, analyzing funnel impact, and scaling what works in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

Develop a regional growth plan that creates and captures demand with small to medium sized businesses.
Manage lead capture, nurture, sales handoff, and post-campaign follow-up plans to ensure every program has a measurable impact.
Identify local buyer needs, and trigger moments, then translate them into programs across email, content, webinars, events, and sales activations.
Partner with in-house Performance and Creative teams to execute regional ideas in the market and bring ideas to life across channels and formats.
Partner closely with internal teams across Analytics, Product Management, Product Marketing, Sales, Marketing Operations, and more to align strategy, execution, reporting, and follow-up.
Partner with Customer Marketing to ensure branded activations and events are fully leveraged across new prospects and existing customers
Build and manage strong relationships with internal stakeholders, external vendors, agencies, industry partners, and field teams to deliver high-quality programs on time and within budget.
Analyze campaign performance to understand how activities, generate qualified leads, influence funnel performance, pipeline creation, conversion, velocity, and revenue outcomes.
Stay close to customer needs, market trends, competitor activity, and emerging marketing technologies to continually improve Deputy ’s regional marketing effectiveness.

5+ years of marketing experience with a proven track record of driving demand generation and pipeline growth in a B2B/SaaS hyper-growth technology environment.
Deep marketing channel expertise spanning gated content, paid ads, webinars, field events, email, content, and sales activations, with a strong understanding of how each channel drives leads and pipeline.
Strong understanding of the B2B marketing funnel, including persona targeting, campaign strategy, lead generation, nurture, attribution, conversion, and pipeline acceleration.
Experience building and managing integrated campaigns across paid, owned, earned, and field channels, from strategy through execution and optimization.
Proven ability to partner with Performance, Creative, Product Marketing, Sales, Marketing Operations, Analytics, and Brand teams to deliver coordinated campaign outcomes.
End-to-end ownership mindset. You execute at pace, directly and through others, take projects across the finish line, own mistakes, and learn from them.
Agility and speed. You constantly try new ideas, pivot quickly when something is not working, and move fast to scale programs that show strong results.
Strong analytical capability, with experience using campaign and funnel data to evaluate performance, optimize spend, and improve return on investment.
Excellent project management skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities, timelines, budgets, stakeholders, and tight deadlines in a dynamic environment.
Experience using Salesforce, Marketo, and related marketing analytics, reporting, or campaign operations tools, or similar applications.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, strong stakeholder management, and comfort working with remote teams located around the world.
Employee Perks - Enjoy a flexible work policy (with a work-from-home stipend to set you up for success at home!) - Own a piece of Deputy through our Employee Share Ownership Plan (ESOP) - Take paid parental leave to support you and your family - We’ll match your 401k contributions to help you save for the future - Access mental health support with Spring Health - Get comprehensive health benefits - Use our commuter reimbursement program - Take additional leave days — including 20 PTO days, study assistance, celebration days and volunteering - Join our global working groups; focused on collaboration, belonging and connection
Deputy believes in equal opportunity and that inclusiveness and diversity promotes innovation. Our global team members are from a variety of cultures. And we welcome different perspective and skills. Originally posted on Himalayas

SKALAR – Wir bauen die digitale Steuerkanzlei der Zukunft
Radikal einfach. Voll digital. 100% mandantenfokussiert.
Wir denken Steuerberatung komplett neu: einfacher, schneller und transparenter für Mandanten und Kanzleiteam zugleich.
Wo andere Kanzleien mit manuellen Prozessen, langen Wartezeiten und intransparenter Kommunikation kämpfen, bauen wir ein völlig neues Erlebnis - digital, proaktiv, KI-gestützt. Mit automatisierten Prozessen im Hintergrund und digitalen Schnittstellen zum Mandanten laufen repetitive Aufgaben weitgehend von selbst - damit du Zeit hast für das, was wirklich zählt: anspruchsvolle Beratung, Sonderfälle und strategische Mandantenfragen.
Der Unterschied zu anderen "Digitalkanzleien": Über die Hälfte unseres Teams sind Softwareentwickler. Du gestaltest direkt mit, was sie bauen - und damit, wie KI-gestützte Steuerberatung in dieser Branche überhaupt aussehen wird. Dein Steuerwissen prägt das Produkt, nicht nur dessen Anwendung.
Wir sind ein erfahrenes Gründerteam aus Steuerberatern, Digital-Unternehmern und Softwareentwicklern mit einem Exit-Track-Record von 140 Mio. €. Mit dir gemeinsam möchten wir eine der führenden Kanzleien Deutschlands aufbauen.
Deine Rolle auf Zeit
Als Interim Marketing Manager übernimmst du für 3–6 Monate die zentrale Marketing-Funktion bei Skalar – von Brand über Content bis Performance. Du überbrückst eine Vakanz, hältst das Momentum unseres Go-to-Market und übergibst am Ende ein sauber aufgesetztes, dokumentiertes Setup.
Du arbeitest im engen Trio mit unserem Co-Founder (Growth)unserem Founding Account Executive und Automation Managerin: Der Growth Manager liefert dir Daten zu Funnel, CAC und Channel-Performance, der Founding AE bringt direkt aus den Sales-Calls, was Mandanten bewegt. Du übersetzt beides in Kampagnen, Content und Brand-Arbeit, die qualifizierte Pipeline erzeugen – und schließt den Loop zurück ins Team.
Der Unterschied zu einer klassischen Festanstellung: Du kommst mit wenig Einarbeitung aus, priorisierst hart auf Wirkung im verfügbaren Zeitfenster und hinterlässt ein übergabefähiges System statt loser Enden.

Performance & Demand Gen
Verschiedene Mid- & Top-of-Funnel Ads testen
Landing Pages, Lead-Magnets und Conversion-Strecken iterieren
Paid-Kampagnen (LinkedIn, Google, Meta) gemeinsam mit dem Growth Manager steuern und optimieren

Laufende Kampagnen, Kanäle und Content-Kalender ohne Reibungsverlust weiterführen

Sales Enablement in enger Schleife mit dem Founding AE: Pitch Decks, One-Pager, Battlecards

Meet DeepL
DeepL is a global AI product and research company focused on building secure, intelligent solutions to complex business problems. Over 200,000 business customers and millions of individuals across 228 global markets today trust DeepL's Language AI platform for human-like translation, improved writing and real-time voice translation.
Founded in 2017 by CEO Jaroslaw “Jarek” Kutylowski, DeepL now has around 1,000 passionate employees and is supported by world-renowned investors including Benchmark, IVP, and Index Ventures.
Our goal is to become the global leader in trusted, intelligent AI technology, building products that drive better communication, foster connections, and create a meaningful impact. To achieve this, we need talented people like you to join our journey. If you’re ready to shape the future of AI and grow your career in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment, DeepL is your next destination.
What sets us apart
What sets us apart is our blend of cutting-edge AI technology, meaningful work, and a culture where people truly thrive. We’re a team of innovators, researchers, and creators driven by a shared purpose to unlock human potential by making work simpler, smarter, and more connected.
When we share what it’s like to work at DeepL, the reactions are overwhelmingly positive. This might be because of our technology that helps millions of people and businesses communicate and work better every day, or because of the trust, curiosity, and care that shape our culture.
What we know for sure is this: being part of DeepL means joining a team dedicated to innovation, growth, and well-being. Discover more about life at DeepL on LinkedIn , Instagram , and our Blog .

s.h: Meet the team behind this journey
s.t:
Over 200,000 businesses run on DeepL, and their stories are the most persuasive asset we have. This role puts them front and centre across brand, demand and growth. Buyers evaluating Language AI trust other buyers. We're building the proof that puts customer stories in front of them at scale.
You'll sit in Product Marketing, report to the VP, and work at pace with Field, Brand, Digital, Comms and PR.

Amplify our customers’ success : Surface the stories our customers are already telling within support tickets, sales nominations, deal wins and win-loss interviews, and choose the few that deserve to become full stories. Ship marquee stories (blue-chip, video, event-ready), named case studies and quantified proof points that show DeepL's AI doing real work in real businesses.
Put our customers on the world stage: Press interviews, webinars, keynotes and our Customer Advisory Board advocacy track. You recommend who speaks, agree the narrative with them in advance, and make each appearance count beyond the day itself..
Put a real customer in front of every buyer: Sales and Customer Success come to you when a deal needs a reference. You'll know which customers will speak, what they'll speak about, and how recently each was asked. Sales enablement builds the seller tools - you supply the customers and the proof that goes inside them.
Share stories while they still matter: Stories work hardest published alongside a launch, event or campaign they belong to. You own the run from interview to live asset, including the legal and brand engagement, and keep customer permissions current so nothing sits waiting.
Measures of success (first 12 months)
New marquee stories the field, brand and events teams all pull from.
Named case studies covering every region, product lines and priority verticals
Reference requests resolved within the agreed turnaround time
Stories publishing in the same window as the launch or event they belong to
Clear evidence that deals using a customer reference close at a better rate
Qualities we look for
Proven success in B2B marketing, over many years: customer marketing, content, comms or advocacy, with a track record of stories that engaged buyers and moved deals
Bias for action: you're a self-starter who clears your own hurdles. You do not wait for a brief
Automate before you escalate: when a step is slow, your instinct is to build a way round it. AI is already in your workflow, not on your list of things to try.
Storytelling: genuine curiosity about a customer's business problem, and the instinct to find the narrative inside it
Customer-facing polish: comfortable with customers from first discovery call through to launch
Strategic judgement: you can map advocacy output to our priorities and back the stories that serve them
Operational rigour: you have built the production, approvals and permissions process - and made it fast

Diverse and internationally distributed team : joining our team means becoming part of a large, global community with people of more than 90 nationalities. We're more than just colleagues; we're a group of professionals with a shared mission to connect diverse cultures. Our global presence is growing–we've doubled in size nearly every year, with our employees based in the UK, Germany, the Netherlands, Poland, the US, and Japan, and we continue to expand our network.
Open communication, regular feedback : as a language-focused company, we value the importance of clear, honest communication. We value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and growth mindset makes us better together.
Hybrid work, flexible hours : we offer a hybrid work schedule, with team members coming into the office twice a week. This allows you to engage directly with your team and experience the unique energy of our workspace, while still enjoying the flexibility and comfort of working from home. With flexible working hours and trust in your productivity, we are in sync with your team’s general locations and time zones to foster effective and seamless collaboration.
Virtual Shares - An ownership mindset in every role. We believe everyone should share in our success, and that’s why every employee receives Virtual Shares, linking your contribution directly to DeepL’s growth and rewarding you with a stake in our future.
Regular in-person team events : we bond over vibrant events that are as unique as our team, from local team and business unit gatherings, to new-joiner onboardings, to company-wide events that bring us all together–literally.
Monthly full-day hacking sessions : every month, we have Hack Fridays, where you can spend your time diving into a project you're passionate about and get the opportunity to work with other teams–we value your initiatives, impact, and creativity.
30 days of annual leave : we value your peace of mind. With 30 days off (excluding public holidays) and access to mental health resources, we make sure you're as strong mentally as you are professionally.
Competitive benefits : just as our team spans the globe, so does our benefits package. We've crafted it to reflect the diversity of our team and tailored it to align with your unique location, to ensure you feel supported every step of the way.
If this role and our mission resonate with you, but you're hesitant because you don't check all the boxes, don't let that hold you back. At DeepL, it's all about the value you bring and the growth we can foster together. Go ahead, apply—let's discover your potential together. We can't wait to meet you!

Blavity Inc. is looking for a temporary Email Marketing Coordinator . This role will own the full newsletter production schedule across four brands Blavity, AfroTech, Travel Noire, and HealthStack while maintaining audience health and contributing to weekly KPI reporting.
This is a high-volume, execution-focused role. The ideal candidate has direct experience with Iterable and can build and send 6-8 newsletters per day across a mix of RSS-automated and fully manual builds with confidence.

All workflows are documented; the expectation is that you follow established processes precisely while flagging issues clearly and escalating when needed. The ideal candidate will implement updates including newsletter redesigns, send time optimization, and template rebuilds, as directed without disrupting the send schedule.
This role will report to the Director of Growth Marketing.

Send Execution (primary focus)
Own 6-8 newsletter sends per day across four brands, building each according to documented workflows and the established send calendar
Execute a mix of RSS-automated and fully manual builds, each requiring property-specific preparation work completed before every send
Apply editorial judgment to manual properties, drawing on content performance data to inform curation decisions
Communicate proactively and professionally with editorial, creative, and engineering stakeholders providing timely status updates, flagging blockers early, and escalating issues with clear context
Administer Pre-Send QA, a checklist that covers copy and content, links and assets, suppression and compliance, audience and list integrity, technical rendering, and scheduling
Maintain a clear, up-to-date picture of your full send schedule and build windows, and communicate proactively when that schedule is affected.
KPI & Benchmark Reporting
Maintain weekly audience snapshots and list health metrics across all properties
Contribute to bi-weekly KPI reporting, highlighting editorial newsletter metrics and trends
Communicate proactively on task status, including when work is in progress or behind
Platform Coordination
Navigate Iterable across its full feature set: campaign builds, audience management, analytics, and template tools
Identify and document platform issues clearly, distinguishing between platform-side problems and execution errors, and escalate to the right team with full context

Hands-on experience with Iterable is required. You must be able to navigate campaign builds, audience lists, segmentation, and drag-and-drop templates from day one.
Experience managing high-volume email production: multiple properties, multiple sends per week, across a mix of automated and manual workflows
Demonstrated QA discipline: ability to follow a multi-step checklist under time pressure without skipping steps
Ability to read campaign analytics and identify patterns: open rates, click-through rates, engagement data
Strong process discipline: documented workflows must be followed exactly; the ability to execute consistently without reinventing the approach is essential
Clear communication: proactive about flagging blockers, escalating issues, and reporting progress, even when work is incomplete
Ability to research answers independently using available tools before escalating. Comfort using AI tools and platform-native resources to get unstuck is expected.
Proficiency in Claude, Google Suite, and Asana

HTML/CSS for email
Google Analytics for editorial content performance analysis
Experience with editorial newsletter properties serving Black and multicultural audiences
What Success Looks Like
A strong temp in this role is reliable, motivated, data-centric, and communicative. In the first 30 days, success means:
All newsletters go out on schedule with no missed sends
Every send has a completed QA checklist and documented approval before it goes out
Briefings, inclusions, and list snapshots are completed before deadlines without reminders
Platform and content issues are flagged to the manager quickly, with clear context
KPI data is entered accurately with anomalies noted
Slack messages are acknowledged; the manager is never uncertain whether instructions have been seen
Each send reflects the brand it represents. Voice, standards, and audience expectations are understood and applied consistently.
At 60–90 days, success means the team continues operating at its normal pace or better with in-flight design and strategy projects progressing on schedule.

Meta ad accounts end-to-end across brands: structure, budgets, pacing, and scaling
The creative testing engine: an always-on testing calendar with clear hypotheses per test (hook, angle, format, audience)

Briefing and directing UGC creators and our video editor; writing hooks and ad copy in English
Full-funnel performance: landing pages and lead forms, CAPI setup and event match quality, and speed-to-lead handoffs with our sales teams
Seasonal campaign planning around registration windows (fall/winter/spring/summer sessions, camps, leagues)
Localized campaigns done right: geo-radius targeting, small remarketing pools, frequency management in limited markets
A weekly scorecard in business terms: registrations, CPL, CAC, and blended efficiency — not vanity metrics

3+ years hands-on Meta buying in **direct-response lead generation** — local services, gyms/fitness, education/enrollment, events, memberships. (Ecommerce-only backgrounds usually don't translate here.)

Measurement literacy: attribution windows, click vs. view-through, blended CAC vs. in-platform ROAS, and healthy skepticism about what Ads Manager claims
Fluent English, written and spoken — all customer-facing copy is English
Comfort with spreadsheet-level analysis and cohorting performance by creative
Full-time availability with 4+ hours of daily overlap with US Eastern Time

Own EMEA partner communications - ensuring clarity, consistency, and regional relevance across all touchpoints.

Ensure global updates, product launches, and programme changes are effectively translated into regional context and landed with partners in a timely way.

Small business owners didn't start their business to become their own bookkeeper, banker, and collections department. Jobber is changing that, building the financial hub for a $400B home-services market, and Fintech is how we get there.
The future of financial services is embedded, and we're still early. For decades, small businesses ran their finances through a patchwork: a bank for payments, a lender for capital, a spreadsheet for everything else. That's ending. The next generation of financial services won't live at a bank, it'll live inside the software businesses already use to run their day. More and more, vertical SaaS platforms like Jobber won't just help small businesses operate; they'll become their financial hub.
Jobber is building for that world. We already help home service pros get paid faster, secure the capital they need to grow, and see their financial health clearly, and we've only scratched the surface. We're looking for a Senior Manager, Product Marketing (Fintech) to own the commercial story that gets us there, as part of our growing Product & Lifecycle Marketing team.
Our culture of transparency, inclusivity, collaboration, and innovation has been recognized by Great Place to Work, Canada’s Most Admired Corporate Cultures, and more. Jobber has also been named on the Globe and Mail’s Canada’s Top Growing Companies list, and Deloitte Canada’s Technology Fast 50™, Enterprise Fast 15, and Technology Fast 500™ lists.

With an Executive team that has over thirty years of industry experience of leading the way, we’ve come a long way from our first customer in 2011, but we’ve just scratched the surface of what we want to accomplish for our customers .

At Jobber, we're not just building software, we're helping home service businesses accelerate revenue growth, improve profitability, and maintain healthy cash flow. Our Product Marketing Fintech team is central to this mission: enabling businesses to get paid faster, secure the capital needed for growth, and gain clarity on their financial health.

This is not a launch-execution role. Reporting to our Senior Director, Product & Lifecycle Marketing, you'll own Marketing-influenced revenue for Jobber's entire Fintech portfolio; adoption, activation, usage, and revenue across payments, financing, and capital are your numbers.

It's a career-defining opportunity to lead the adoption of Fintech in one of the largest remaining B2B markets, partner with the best-of-the-best in the space, and help small businesses succeed while you do it. If you think like a business owner and want to lead a team that moves the needle on revenue, this is the role.

s.h: The Senior Manager, Product Marketing (Fintech) , will
s.t:
Lead and develop the team: Coach and grow a team of Product Marketers and Lifecycle Marketers across payments, consumer financing, lending, and new products, building an inclusive, high-performing culture that values learning, accountability, and collaboration, and supporting career growth through regular coaching and feedback.
Own the Fintech GTM strategy and roadmap: Develop and own the end-to-end Fintech Marketing strategy with your team, identifying the highest-leverage opportunities, focusing the team's energy there, and translating insight into action plans that balance customer value with Jobber's revenue goals
Own the commercial number: Sit at the intersection of Marketing and Fintech GTM operations and own Marketing-influenced revenue growth for the portfolio. Champion commercial rigor and set the performance rhythm, including ownership of key Fintech KPIs
Build a culture of experimentation: Run tests across segments and metrics to identify what drives Fintech revenue, own the analytics to prove it, and partner with stakeholders to grow the winners into bigger investment bets over time
Stay relentlessly customer-first: Contribute to qualitative and quantitative research alongside Product, and hunt down the insights that sharpen positioning, messaging, and strategy
Partner deeply cross-functionally: Work with Fintech leadership, Product Management, Finance, and GTM teams to shape roadmap, pricing, and promotional opportunities, grounded in what customers need, what drives revenue, and what creates competitive differentiation in SMB Fintech
Be the Fintech Marketing SME: Represent Product & Lifecycle Marketing as the Fintech Marketing subject-matter leader across the org, collaborating with Product, Sales, Success, Risk Operations, Finance, and Analytics to deliver cohesive Fintech experiences
Operate as a player/coach: Own overall strategy while modelling the standard and rolling up your sleeves where the business needs it most
What good looks like
Net Fintech revenue driven by Marketing compounds quarter over quarter
Adoption and attach rates accelerate across payments, financing, and capital
Jobber markets Fintech as a crucial and integrated part of its offering
The team runs on commercial rigor, with every bet tied to a clear revenue impact
Positioning and messaging are sharp enough that Product, Sales, and Success all tell the same story

s.h: To be successful, you should have
s.t:
Have extensive experience in Product Marketing, Lifecycle Marketing, or Growth Marketing and dedicated people leadership experience, with a strong track record of owning and scaling commercial outcomes, not just launch execution
Strong understanding of financial services and payments business models in high-growth SaaS environment
Best-in-class positioning and messaging, you create, educate, and influence teams on how to bring Fintech products to life
Proven ability to lead, motivate, influence, and navigate complex organizations with multiple cross-functional stakeholders, and build trust quickly across functions
The ability to self-direct in ambiguous environments, you don't wait for a playbook, you build one
Highly analytical, confident making recommendations with incomplete information, with a strong bias to action over analysis paralysis
A business owner's mindset, you naturally gravitate toward "what's the revenue impact?" over "what's the campaign plan?"
A coaching mindset, you develop people by giving them ownership and holding them accountable to outcomes
AI fluency, you're comfortable using AI tools in your own workflow and marketing AI-powered products, and you have a point of view on how AI reshapes Fintech marketing

1Password is growing. We’ve surpassed $400M in ARR and we’re continuing to accelerate, earning a spot on the Forbes Cloud 100 for four years in a row and teaming up with iconic partners like Oracle Red Bull Racing.
About 1Password
At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted.

We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience.

Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work.
If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future.
We’re looking for a Digital Customer Success Campaign Manager to design, launch, and improve digital customer journeys at scale. You’ll turn customer and product signals into timely, useful programs that help customers move from trial through activation, adoption, and ongoing value. This is a hands-on, program-focused role for someone who enjoys combining thoughtful communication, data, experimentation, and emerging technology.
Reporting into the Senior Manager, Digital Customer Success, this role is based remotely in North America, with hiring locations in the United States or Canada.
How we’re using AI today
Across GTM, we’re transforming the way we work with AI. We expect every seller, CSM, and team member to become a power user, using it daily to work smarter and move faster.

AI is already embedded in how we operate – from real-time coaching that sharpens how we sell and interact with customers, to surfacing insights that help us anticipate needs – creating more time for meaningful customer engagement. If you’re excited to reshape how you think, make decisions, and drive growth with AI, you’ll feel right at home here.

· Bring experience in Digital Customer Success, Customer Marketing, Lifecycle Marketing, Growth Operations, Customer Success Operations, or Product-led Growth within a Software as a Service (SaaS) environment.

· Have owned or significantly contributed to lifecycle or digital customer programs with measurable impact.

· Write clear, engaging customer-facing communications and adapt messaging for different audiences and customer needs.

· Interpret customer and product usage data, identify patterns, and turn insights into practical campaign and journey improvements.

· Work effectively across Customer Success, Product, Marketing, Data, Operations, and Content teams while navigating changing priorities and building new programs from the ground up.

· Experience using artificial intelligence (AI) tools to accelerate campaign development, analysis, experimentation, or content creation.

· Experience with 1Password, cybersecurity, or a similar technology product.

· Design, launch, and continuously improve digital customer journeys across onboarding, activation, adoption, expansion, and renewal.

· Develop targeted campaigns that help customers move from trial to meaningful product adoption and guide them toward the right next step.

· Draft, edit, and optimize customer-facing email campaigns, connecting them with education resources and other digital experiences.

· Use customer signals, milestones, and behaviors to identify moments of friction or opportunity and create timely interventions.

· Monitor campaign performance through metrics such as engagement, activation, product usage, retention, and expansion; use experimentation and cohort analysis to improve results.

· Partner with Data and Analytics teams to support dashboards and reporting, then use those insights to make informed recommendations.

· Collaborate with Product, Customer Success, Marketing, Operations, and Content partners to keep programs accurate, useful, and aligned with the customer journey.

· Use tools such as Gainsight, Salesforce, marketing automation platforms, and AI solutions to increase campaign quality, testing speed, and operational efficiency.
This role is ideal for someone who enjoys building in an evolving environment, can work independently through ambiguity, and is motivated by creating scalable customer experiences that help more people get value from 1Password.

This role is also immediate participation in 1Password's benefits program (health, dental, 401k and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

At 1Password, we prioritize collaboration, clear and transparent communication, receptiveness to feedback, and alignment with our core values: keep it simple, lead with honesty, and put people first.
You’ll be part of a team that challenges the status quo, and is excited to experiment and iterate in search of the best solution. That said, 1Password is not for everyone . Our work is demanding, we strive for excellence, and the pace is fast.

We need people who are keen to take on challenging problems, who seek feedback to grow, and who are driven to make an impact. If you're looking for a place where you can settle into a comfortable routine, this might not be the right fit for you.

We’re looking for individuals who are proven experts in their fields, as well as those who are highly adaptable, can thrive in ambiguity and through change, are curious, and above all deliver results.
How we work with AI
We are committed to leveraging cutting-edge technology—including AI—to achieve our mission.

We also understand that thinking critically about AI in its current forms will help us create better solutions for our customers and ourselves with its future forms, which will help us continue to close the gap between security and privacy and achieve our mission.

We want team members at all levels to take the approach of actively learning AI best practices, identifying opportunities to apply AI in meaningful ways, and driving innovative solutions in their daily work. Embracing the future of AI isn't just encouraged—it's an essential part of how we will be successful at 1Password.

In dieser Rolle arbeitest du Seite an Seite mit unserem Senior-Team, um echte Herausforderungen in einem komplexen Markt zu lösen.
Wir verlangen keine Berufserfahrung – nur eine ausgeprägte Affinität zu Technologie und die Fähigkeit, technische Konzepte schnell zu begreifen.
Deine Aufgaben
Du übernimmst Verantwortung für konkrete Projekte, die unsere Roadmap und Strategie direkt beeinflussen, zum Beispiel:
Wettbewerbsanalyse: Du recherchierst und analysierst die Strategien unserer Wettbewerber (z. B. Datadog, Dynatrace, Nagios), um uns dabei zu helfen, unsere Positionierung zu schärfen.
User Research: Du nimmst an Interviews mit IT-Administratoren und DevOps-Ingenieuren teil, um deren Probleme („Pain Points“) zu verstehen und neue Ideen zu validieren.
Produktanalyse & PLG: Du analysierst Nutzerflüsse, um Reibungspunkte zu identifizieren und schlägst konkrete „Product-Led Growth“-Initiativen zur Verbesserung der User Experience vor.
Marktanalyse: Du recherchierst Trends in den Bereichen Observability, Cloud-Monitoring und Hybrid-IT, um neue Marktchancen für uns zu identifizieren.
Content-Support: Du hilfst dabei, komplexe technische Features in klare Wertversprechen für unsere Website, interne Dokumentationen und Vertriebsmaterialien zu übersetzen.
Dein Profil Technik-Affinität: Du musst kein Entwickler sein, aber du solltest eine Faszination dafür haben, wie Software funktioniert. Themen wie Kubernetes, Server-Monitoring oder Cloud-Infrastruktur wecken deine Neugier.
Schnelle Auffassungsgabe: Du kannst komplexe technische Informationen rasch aufnehmen und einfach erklären.
Analytische Denkweise: Es macht dir Spaß, Daten oder qualitatives Feedback in klare Muster und Erkenntnisse zu übersetzen.
Kommunikationsstärke: Ausgezeichnete schriftliche und mündliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Englisch (Deutsch ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss für die Arbeit im internationalen Team).
Studentenstatus: Du bist aktuell an einer Hochschule eingeschrieben (BWL, Informatik, Ingenieurwesen oder vergleichbar) und für [20] Stunden pro Woche verfügbar.
Warum wir? Die Chance, die Zukunft eines dynamischen, schnell wachsenden Technologieunternehmens entscheidend mitzugestalten und dabei mit Deinen Aufgaben und Deiner Verantwortung zu wachsen

Own positioning and messaging for Source CMS and DAM.
Run launches and feature-release support end to end.
Maintain competitive coverage for the content and marketing-cloud category with support from our head of competitive intelligence
Build AEO / AI-citation proof points and sales-play assets on a value-selling spine (Signal > Value > Action).
Partner with the Source Evangelist (user-facing proof and technical content) and with Demand Gen.

5+ years in product marketing or a closely related role.
A strategist, not a content marketer. You think critically about the moments of impact and drive the positioning, rather than producing assets on a treadmill.
AI-first ways of working. You use AI to move faster and automate low-value work, and you can tell real agentic strategy from automation in a dressed-up costume.
Presentation and demo skills. Everyone here presents and demos on stage; you are compelling live, in a product demo, a customer session, or a conference talk.
Strong, clear writing that turns product capability into marketing-buyer value, and reliable launch execution.
Experience in CMS and DAM categories is a must

Working knowledge of AEO / GEO.
Familiarity with Drupal and the Acquia product line

Translate complex technical products and features into compelling, differentiated messaging - producing high-quality materials across the full content spectrum, including emails, blogs, case studies, landing pages, one-sheeters, and sales enablement.

FLUX gets attention the moment people see it. Your job is to turn that attention into pipeline.

Marketing at Intapp is organized around vertical go-to-market motions — and the financial services segment is one of the most complex and competitive.

The Campaign Manager, Financial Services sits at the center of that effort, owning the full campaign lifecycle for a vertical that spans private equity, investment banking, capital markets, and alternative asset management.

Reporting to the Global Paid Media and Financial Services GTM Programs Director, this role has direct influence on how Intapp shows up with buyers and how marketing moves pipeline.
Day to day, this means translating business priorities and active sales plays into integrated, multi-channel demand generation campaigns — managing briefs, audience targeting, timelines, asset development, and performance reporting across a wide set of stakeholders.

You'll work closely with PMM, creative, marketing operations, field marketing, and editorial to keep programs on strategy and on schedule, and you'll be the person who turns campaign data into clear signals for the sales team and senior leadership.

Experience with B2B campaign operations, marketing automation platforms, project management tools, and financial services industry contexts will all be relevant here.

s.h: As a Campaign Manager, Financial Services, you can expect to
s.t:
Design and execute integrated, multi-channel demand generation campaigns across the financial services verticals, managing timelines, briefs, and launch plans from kickoff through measurement.
Own audience deployment in partnership with Marketing Operations — requesting and validating lists, segment filters, suppression logic, and play-based targeting to protect the buyer journey and cover gaps in target account coverage.
Lead cross-functional working teams across PMM, creative, partner marketing, client marketing, editorial, and channel owners to drive campaign execution from brief to launch.
Build and maintain a full-year integrated marketing plan that spans campaign sequencing, content milestones, paid activations, and event overlaps across all marketing functions.
Report campaign performance to senior stakeholders and sales leadership through regular readout meetings, QBRs, and steering committee presentations, translating data into pipeline impact and actionable recommendations.
Track deliverables, dependencies, and readiness in Asanawith cross-functional teamstomonitorrisks, delays, and approvals.

Intapp is looking for intellectually curious, self-motivated professionals who like to get hands-on to contribute to the overall success of the business and their team.
Demonstrated experience in demand generation, campaign operations, or lifecycle marketing in a B2B environment, with a track record of executing programs that move pipeline
Strong cross-functional project leadership skills — comfortable managing multiple simultaneous workstreams, dependencies, and stakeholders across a matrixed organization
Familiarity with CRM, marketing automation, and campaign management platforms such as Marketo, HubSpot, Salesforce, Demandbase, or Pardot
An analytical mindset — able to diagnose funnel bottlenecks, interpret performance data, and translate insights into campaign adjustments
GTM and messaging fluency — able to connect campaign strategy to business objectives and engage credibly with field sales, PMM, and senior leadership
Experience in the financial services industry or within a highly matrixed organization

6sense's mission is to multiply what matters: growth, retention, and efficiency. We envision a future where companies, teams and people reach their full potential.

People are the heart and soul of 6sense. We serve with passion and purpose. We live by our Being 6sense values of Win as One Team, Stay Curious, Do The Right Thing, Own the Outcome, and Create Belonging.

Every 6sensor plays a part in deﬁning the future of our industry-leading technology. 6sense is a place where difference-makers roll up their sleeves, take risks, act with integrity, and measure success by the value we create for our customers. We want 6sense to be the best chapter of your career.
As our Partner Marketing Manager you will be responsible for turning strategic partnerships into a measurable pipeline motion- building the co-marketing programs, and partner activation strategies that help communicate the power of 6Sense alongside our key partners. This is a builder's role for someone who wants to own a meaningful piece of how 6sense grows, and who understands that great partner marketing sits at the intersection of relationship depth and disciplined execution.

Joint Go-to-Market Programs
Build and run co-marketing programs with strategic partners, from end to end: partner alignment, asset development, campaign execution, field activation, and measurement. Own the pipeline contribution from partner marketing activity and be accountable for reporting it clearly.
Joint Events and Activations
Own the partner presence at key industry events (including our own, BreakThrough ), co-hosted webinars, and joint field programs. Coordinate logistics, messaging, and follow-up across both sides of the partnership to make sure activations generate pipeline.
Partner Relationships
Serve as the primary marketing counterpart to partner marketing and alliances teams at key accounts. Build the kind of working relationships where partner counterparts are actively seeking us out. Create opportunities for 6sense to co-present at joint events, and develop the trust that makes joint programs move faster.
Partner Marketing Metrics
Define what success looks like for partner marketing at 6sense, working with marketing operations to build the reporting infrastructure to measure it, and communicate results to marketing leadership and BD stakeholders on a regular cadence.
Performance Measurement
Partner-Sourced Pipeline
Volume and velocity of pipeline generated through co-marketing programs and partner activations, tracked with clear attribution.
Partner Marketing Engagement
Depth of engagement from partner counterparts: co-investment in programs, co-branded content produced, joint events executed, and partner-sourced leads generated.
Enablement Adoption
Usage and effectiveness of partner-facing enablement materials, measured by partner sales team feedback and co-sell conversation rates.
Program Execution Quality
On-time, on-brief delivery of co-marketing programs - with the partner relationship strengthened as a result.

Influence Without Authority Operates effectively in an environment where the people you most depend on (partner counterparts, internal sales, product marketing) don't report into the same leadership. Builds alignment through credibility and relationships.
Revenue-First Thinking Connects every program to pipeline and revenue. Doesn't measure success by content produced or events run. Asks "what did this produce?" and builds programs that are designed to answer that question.
Partner-Facing Presence Comfortable representing 6sense externally. Shows up in partner conversations with enough confidence and preparation to be a genuine asset in the room.
Execution Discipline Manages the complexity of co-marketing at pace. Gets joint programs across the finish line even when approval chains are complex.
Cross-Functional Orchestration Works fluidly across product marketing, demand generation, content, field marketing, and BD to bring partner programs to life.

5 or more years in B2B marketing, with at least 2 years in a field marketing role, partner marketing, alliance marketing, or ecosystem marketing role where you owned outcomes and field programs.
Experience working directly with external partner stakeholders. You have presented to partner leadership, negotiated co-marketing agreements, and maintained productive relationships through disagreements.
A clear point of view on how to measure partner marketing impact, including how to handle the attribution ambiguity that comes with the territory.
Familiarity with the B2B SaaS technology ecosystem: how ISV partnerships, technology integrations, and co-sell motions work in practice.
