About Chili Piper
Chili Piper is a B2B SaaS company that helps GTM teams turn inbound leads into qualified meetings - instantly. Our Demand Conversion Platform makes it easier for buyers and sellers to connect fast, without the usual friction in the funnel.
We’re a fully remote, global team that loves building solutions that truly help our customers, moving fast, and having fun while creating something meaningful. We’re growing quickly and aiming big!

At Chili Piper, community and events are at the heart of our GTM strategy. From intimate dinners to large-scale activations like our annual ChiliPalooza, we bring top GTM leaders together to connect, exchange ideas, and build lasting relationships. It's how we turn a room full of people into real pipeline, and how we've built a community that actually wants to hear from us.
We're hiring an Events Manager to scale these experiences and deepen our relationships with the GTM community: executive dinners, industry conferences, sponsorships, speaking moments, webinars, and ChiliPalooza. This is the person who turns our presence in a room, physical or virtual, into brand awareness, pipeline, and lasting relationships.
This role is part of our marketing team and works cross-functionally with Sales and Partnerships to run Chili Piper's global event strategy. You'll have real ownership of the calendar and where we show up, not just the execution. You'll shape the annual plan, then make it happen: logistics, promotion, on-site, and follow-up, all the way through to measurable impact.
This is a hands-on role. You're the one building the landing pages, pulling the CRM lists, and running the show on-site, not handing a brief to an agency and waiting. It's a strong fit for someone who is organized and proactive, thinks creatively about how we show up, and brings original ideas and a sense of humor to every event. It's fully remote, with travel to events as needed.

Own the annual event calendar. Decide, with marketing leadership, where Chili Piper should have a presence and why, and protect that focus as new opportunities come up
Bring original ideas, creativity, and humor to how we show up, so our events feel like Chili Piper and not like everyone else's
Manage execution end to end. Logistics, budgets, venues, vendors, shipments, swag, and on-site coordination, done by you and tracked by you
Run event promotion from start to finish. Build event and webinar landing pages, export and segment contact lists from Salesforce and HubSpot to target the right attendees by city or segment, and send invites, reminders, and follow-ups independently
Produce our virtual events and webinars end to end, from speaker prep and rehearsal to running the live show
Collaborate across teams. With Marketing on branding, design, and promotion; with Sales to identify and invite the right prospects and customers; with Partnerships to coordinate sponsors and activations
Ensure smooth on-site execution. Keep schedules on track and deliver a seamless experience from load-in to last handshake
Build and nurture community. Deepen our relationships with GTM leaders, partners, and community members so our events compound over time
Track performance. Collect attendee data, measure engagement, and report on outcomes and pipeline impact
Amplify results. Work with Marketing to repurpose event content, including photos, videos, and testimonials, for social and post-event communication
Manage vendors and budgets. Source partners, negotiate rates, and keep quality high and costs in check
Run the debrief on every event and turn what you learn into a stronger program next time

Builder mindset. You don't wait for someone to tell you how, you figure it out
Tech-savvy operator. You know your way around CRM exports, spreadsheets, event tools, and email automation
Hands-on doer. You do the execution and track the results yourself
Creative problem-solver. When a venue cancels or a vendor flakes, you find a workaround fast, and when the format is stale, you invent a better one
Organized and proactive. You turn chaos into systems and think two steps ahead
Strong communicator. You coordinate cross-functional teams, vendors, and execs smoothly
Customer-first. You care about memorable, frictionless experiences from invite to post-event follow-up
Curious and eager to learn. You're always exploring new tools, trends, and ideas, including AI, to make each event better than the last
Experience
2+ years in event management, field marketing, or community roles, ideally in B2B SaaS
Proven ability to plan and execute events, from small dinners to large activations
Hands-on experience with CRM tools like Salesforce and HubSpot, and event platforms like Luma, Zoom Webinars or similar
Comfortable building simple landing pages, managing email lists, and running event promotion campaigns
Skilled in vendor sourcing, budget tracking, and on-site coordination
Strong cross-functional collaboration with Marketing, Sales, and Partnerships
Excellent organizational and communication skills, with the ability to work independently and manage shifting priorities
Familiar with tracking and reporting event performance, including attendance, engagement, and pipeline impact
Experience managing partner collaborations or maintaining relationships with GTM leaders and communities is a plus

Experience in B2B SaaS, RevOps, or MarTech
Prior involvement in partner activations or co-marketing events
Experience managing sponsorships or collaborations with other brands
Comfortable using analytics tools to measure event outcomes
A strong network within the GTM, Sales, or Marketing communities
Background in social or content amplification around events, for example capturing and repurposing event moments

Application review. We'll review your background and experience to make sure there's a good fit for the role.
Culture add interview. A first chat to get to know you: what drives you, how you like to work, and what unique perspective you'd bring to Chili Piper.
Assessment. A short, practical assignment to see how you think and approach a real events challenge. It's not a test, we just want to see your creativity and thought process.
Executive interview. The final step. We'll talk about your bigger picture, your passion for the space, your understanding of our product, and why Chili Piper feels like the right next step for you.

We're not hiring a "planner." We're hiring someone who can own the full experience, from the CRM export to the on-site execution to the community that keeps growing after everyone goes home, and turn GTM moments into momentum and measurable results.
If that sounds like you, we want to talk.

The Opportunity
Billions have gone into enterprise AI. Most of it isn't working — organisations still can't turn model capability into measurable business impact. That's not a training problem or a slide-deck problem. It's a hard, unsolved technical challenge: building the systems that translate what AI can do into how work actually gets done inside real organisations, at scale, with proof it's working. That's the problem Multiverse exists to solve, and it's the one this role exists to sell.

Partner cross-functionally with Product, Sales, Customer Success, and Marketing to align teams, deliver effective launches, and maintain trust with high-expectation stakeholders.
Champion the voice of the customer in product and commercial decisions via research, feedback, and market analysis, collaborating with external research partners when useful.

Track record of impact and excellence leading product marketing or strategy initiatives at hyper-growth companies.
Proactive, effective communicator who adapts easily to changing priorities within a diverse, distributed team.
Positive-sum mentality, balancing high-level strategic reflection with a willingness to roll up your sleeves and execute.

High internal expectations for what is possible, coupled with the ability to bring others along on that journey.
Confident user of AI to improve the speed and quality of your work, raising the bar for what is possible within the team.
Adept at building workflows from scratch: turning ambiguous, 0-to-1 briefs into clear plans with defined success metrics, and owning timelines end-to-end.

Über uns
myDartpfeil ist ein deutsches E-Commerce-Unternehmen mit Sitz in Berlin und Technologieführer im Onlinehandel für individuell konfigurierbare Dartpfeile. Mit unserem eigens entwickelten Dartpfeil-Konfigurator bieten wir Kundinnen und Kunden weltweit die Möglichkeit, ihre ganz persönlichen Darts zusammenzustellen – individuell, hochwertig und unkompliziert.
Seit unserer Gründung im Jahr 2017 haben wir uns kontinuierlich weiterentwickelt und gehören heute zu den innovativsten Anbietern im boomenden Dartssegment. Wir verkaufen über unseren eigenen Shop (Shopify Plus), Amazon und B2B-Partner – und ein wesentlicher Teil unserer Wertschöpfung entsteht direkt bei uns im Haus, von der UV-Flachbett- und Textilveredelung über Lasergravuren bis zur Endkonfektion.
Stellenausschreibung
Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams in Berlin suchen wir eine Persönlichkeit, die mit einem der Gründer zusammen unser Marketing ganzheitlich verantwortet: Du steuerst ein jährliches Media-Budget von über 1 Mio. Euro über Paid Ads, entwickelst CRM, SEO und neue Kanäle weiter – und baust dabei Prozesse auf, in denen AI-Tools fester Bestandteil der täglichen Arbeit sind.
Aufgaben
Paid Ads: Planung, Steuerung und Skalierung unserer Kampagnen auf Meta und Google (Search, Shopping, PMax, YouTube) – Budgetverantwortung von über 1 Mio. Euro pro Jahr, inklusive Testing, Attribution und laufender Optimierung auf ROAS und Neukundenkosten
Creatives: Konzeption, Briefing und Erstellung von Ad-Creatives (Video, Statics, UGC) – hands-on, mit AI-gestützten Tools und in Zusammenarbeit mit Freelancern; Auswertung der Performance auf Creative-Ebene

Hi, I’m Harriet, Ashby’s VP Marketing. I joined Ashby in August 2022 to lead the Marketing function. My career journey has been anything but linear starting out as a yoga teacher, working as an M&A lawyer, before finding my happy place in marketing. This is a common theme across the team, and we love to see people who have built their skills both inside and outside the marketing discipline.
Over the past ~4 years, we’ve gone from a stealth brand to the default operating system for over 5,000 of the most ambitious companies in tech, finance, and healthcare.

On this journey, we’ve also amassed a marketing team of ~30 folks from across North America and Europe who are some of the brightest and most humble humans that want to ‘win’, and have fun doing so.

Our culture is focused on creating a space to do lots of career-defining work with the tools, people, and focus that means minimal thrash and lots of autonomy. You can learn a little more about how we work here and why our investors are excited about us here .
For this role, we are looking for someone to lead demand generation for our enterprise segment in Europe. You will have a fantastic thought partner and US counterpart, Ben , as well as the autonomy to rethink and define the strategy and execution to fit the nuances of the different European markets.

It’s ABM but not in its traditional form: we’re seeking a first-principles thinker who prioritizes meaningful engagement over generic tactics / outdated playbooks (for example, prioritizing a few key impactful moments of engagement over running a laundry list of generic tactics across digital channels).
If working with both the sales and marketing team to find and convert enterprise pipeline in a low ego, highly ambitious environment appeals, we’d love to hear from you!
What you’ll be responsible for in this role
Partner with Ben to define our EMEA enterprise ABM strategy and the channels we bet on with consideration to broader global strategy and nuances of respective European markets. Here you play the critical role of orchestrator, pulling together all of the relevant marketing channels to support a delightful discovery and prospect journey and are the point person for your counterparts in Sales.
Research and build prospect journey maps for target accounts, and develop the messaging, content, and creative that bring them to life, with support from our PMM, content, and creative teams.
Work with sales and revenue operations to build target account lists that combine data signals with rep input, and own the methodology behind them — how cohorts are built, what assumptions they rest on, and how we measure whether accounts are actually moving.
Manage our agency partners, including our gifting agency, Wildcard, to get campaigns executed well and fast.
Execute on the strategy you define which will include activities like working with your events counterpart on the coordination of dinners, activations , ancillary conference events, and stunts.
Apply our experimentation framework to run short sprints, learn quickly what works, and localise content, creative, and campaign strategy for EMEA markets.

s.h: You will probably love this role if
s.t:
You enjoy combining data and creative thinking — and you have taste. You can tell the difference between messaging that's genuinely compelling and messaging that's generic or cheesy.
You're prospect-obsessed. You can step into the seat of the personas you're marketing to and build campaigns that meet them where they are, at the right time, with the right message.
You are deeply curious and not afraid to break from traditional ABM playbooks.
You build trust across functions. Sales managers and reps are excited to work with you, and the marketing team is fully bought into your campaign ideas and asks.
You understand (and leverage) the massive advantage AI creates but not so pilled that you let efficiency gains undercut creativity and taste.

s.h: This role is not for you if
s.t:
You'd rely solely on 6sense (or equivalent) as your only source of truth.
You're strong on one half of the job but not the other. You need to move comfortably between building and interpreting dashboards, and writing compelling copy and developing creative with our gifting agency and creative teams.
You lean heavily on existing playbooks and tactics rather than stepping back and thinking from first principles. A lot of how we market at Ashby is deliberately different; curiosity and adaptability are critical.
You aren't able to operate with autonomy and run strategies end-to-end. We give clear ownership and trust you with it; you should be proactive and resourceful.
You believe that EMEA is one homogeneous market
Interview Plan
At Ashby, our team and interview process want to help you show your best self. We’ll dive into past projects and simulate working together via project working sessions. Our interview process is five rounds:
30-minute intro call with Michelle (Recruiting).
45-minute interview with Harriet (Hiring Manager).
45-minute interview with Ben (US lead on ABM).
A take-home assignment, which you’ll have 40 mins to discuss with the hiring team.
A virtual on-site of 1.5 hours with a panel of interviewers.
Nhi (Strategic Projects Lead)
Casper (Head of ENT Sales, EMEA)
Antonio (AI & Automations Lead, Demand Gen)

Opportunity to work with a talented and passionate team.
10-year exercise window for stock options . You shouldn’t feel pressure to purchase stock options if you leave Ashby —do it when you feel financially comfortable.
Unlimited PTO with four weeks recommended per year. Expect “Vacation?” in our one-on-one agenda until you start taking it .
Generous equipment, software, and office furniture budget. Get what you need to be happy and productive!
$100/month education budget with more expensive items (like conferences) covered with manager approval.
Ashby’s success hinges on hiring great people and creating an environment where we can be happy, feel challenged, and do our best work. We’re being deliberate about building that environment from the ground up. I hope that excites you enough to apply.

Track which research, prospecting themes, and materials are helping sellers open doors and use those learnings to improve future support.

Quickly identify the most relevant existing materials instead of rebuilding presentations from scratch.

Sales Alignment & Enablement

Help sellers navigate available materials, case studies, research, and solution stories so they can self-serve effectively when appropriate.

Sellers have a consistent pipeline of well-researched accounts and stronger reasons to reach out.
Prospecting support contributes to more qualified meetings and new sales conversations.
Smaller and standard opportunities receive fast, polished, relevant presentation support without unnecessary custom development.
Sales spends less time searching for materials and researching accounts and more time engaging customers.
The Associate knows when to activate existing materials and when an opportunity should be escalated for deeper strategic support.

DIRECTV is seeking a Director, Product Marketing – Pricing to lead pricing strategy, planning, and execution across the residential video portfolio. This newly created role will serve as the primary owner of DIRECTV ’s pricing architecture and one of the company’s largest and most sensitive revenue levers.
The Director will lead a team of three pricing professionals and oversee annual price increases, acquisition and rack-rate pricing, customer promotional roll-offs, new package pricing, ancillary fees, and other changes that affect the customer’s bill. The role will also establish consistent business-case standards and pricing governance to ensure decisions appropriately balance revenue, margin, acquisition, churn, and long-term customer value.
This leader will work closely with the Packaging, Offers and Lifecycle teams, as well as Finance, Product, Marketing, Content, Technology, Care, Sales, Legal, and Customer Communications. The Director will operate with significant autonomy, translating enterprise objectives into a 6–12-month pricing roadmap and leading complex initiatives from strategic evaluation through implementation and performance measurement.

Annual and In-Year Price Management (30%)
Lead the strategy, modeling, recommendation, and execution of DIRECTV ’s annual base price increase and acquisition price increase.
Develop recommendations for timing, magnitude, sequencing, and customer allocation of price changes.
Direct in-year pricing actions across the portfolio, including changes to SVODs, premium services, sports products, hardware, regional sports fees, broadcast-related charges, administrative fees, and other bill components.
Maintain an integrated roadmap of planned customer bill changes to identify overlapping events, cumulative customer impacts, operational dependencies, and churn risks.
Coordinate execution across Finance, Technology, Billing, Product, Marketing, Care, Sales, Legal, and Customer Communications.
Identify and manage pricing impacts associated with customer migrations, price guarantees, reconnect and winback programs, legacy billing platforms, and other operational dependencies.
Track pricing realization against the approved business case and recommend corrective actions when results differ from plan.
Pricing Architecture and New Package Pricing (20%)
Own the structural integrity of the pricing ladder across Signature packages, Genre Packs, add-ons, premium services, hardware, and other portfolio components in coordination with offers team.
Evaluate and recommend pricing for new packages, products, features, and services.
Partner with the Packaging team to determine how proposed content or product changes affect package economics, price points, step-up relationships, and customer value.
Maintain clear relationships between acquisition prices, promotional prices, roll-off amounts, and ongoing rack rates.
Assess pricing opportunities and other approaches that better align customer pricing with underlying content costs and market conditions.
Monitor competitive pricing, promotional constructs, package composition, and perceived value across traditional pay-TV providers, virtual MVPDs, and direct-to-consumer streaming services.
Pricing Construct and Roll-off Management (20%)
Continuously evaluate which pricing construct best serves the business — including everyday pricing versus roll-off models.
Analyze elasticity, roll-off behavior, and margin impact to inform construct recommendations.
Treat construct evaluation as an ongoing strategic function rather than a periodic review.
Enterprise Revenue Levers and Business Cases (20%)
Build and oversee financial models and business cases for major pricing, packaging, fee, discount, and revenue initiatives.
Establish consistent assumptions, methodologies, and decision criteria for evaluating revenue, margin, churn, acquisition, migration, and customer lifetime value.
Develop scenarios and sensitivities that make key assumptions, risks, and tradeoffs clear to executive decision-makers.
Evaluate pricing for regional sports, broadcast programming, hardware, premiums, SVODs, bolt-ons, and other significant revenue or cost-recovery levers.
Quantify the direct and downstream effects of pricing decisions on gross additions, ACPU, retention, package mix, migration, and long-term profitability.
Partner with Finance to ensure business cases align with forecasts, budgets, content economics, and enterprise financial objectives.
Conduct post-launch measurement to compare actual performance with the approved business case and incorporate learnings into future decisions.
Oversee the development of pricing analytics, tools, and capabilities required to support faster and more rigorous decision-making.
Pricing Governance and Cross-Functional Partnership (10%)
Establish clear pricing governance, approval processes, decision rights, and documentation standards.
Serve as the central point of coordination for proposed changes affecting the customer’s recurring or one-time bill.
Partner with the Offers team to ensure acquisition, retention, winback, proactive, and tactical offers fit within the overall pricing architecture and approved economic guardrails.
Partner with the Packaging team to ensure package design, content decisions, and price points work together to create a logical and competitive customer value proposition.
Bring forward fact-based recommendations that clearly articulate financial opportunity, customer impact, execution requirements, and key risks.
Present pricing strategies and recommendations to senior and executive leadership.
Team Leadership
Lead, coach, and develop a team of pricing analysts and specialists.
Establish clear roles, priorities, performance expectations, and development plans for the team.
Create a high standard for analytical accuracy, financial discipline, executive-ready communication, and executional follow-through.
Ensure the team develops a detailed understanding of customer behavior, competitive dynamics, billing platforms, product economics, and operational dependencies.
Build strong partnerships across functions while maintaining clear accountability for pricing recommendations and outcomes.
Foster a culture of curiosity, constructive challenge, ownership, and continuous improvement.

s.h: What you’ll need to be successful
s.t:
Extensive experience in pricing strategy, revenue management, product strategy, or a related discipline, preferably within subscription, telecommunications, media, entertainment, or another recurring-revenue business.
Demonstrated experience leading large-scale price changes from initial strategy and financial modeling through implementation and performance measurement.
Strong understanding of subscription pricing constructs, including introductory pricing, rack rates, promotional guarantees, roll-offs, fees, discounts, and everyday pricing.
Experience evaluating new product or package pricing and managing pricing relationships across a multi-product portfolio.
Advanced financial modeling and business-case development skills, with a strong understanding of revenue, margin, churn, acquisition, customer lifetime value, and P&L impact.

The Marketing Specialist (MarTech Manager) serves as the strategic lead for the Air Force Services (AFS) Non Appropriated Fund (NAF) marketing technology ecosystem, including the enterprise CMS, eCommerce, analytics, and related digital platforms.

Provides governance, product ownership, and enterprise coordination to ensure digital platforms directly support revenue-generating business units and enterprise marketing objectives.

Operates under the administrative and policy oversight of the Marketing Operations Branch Chief, who retains responsibility for enterprise compliance and inherently governmental functions.

Execute responsibilities in collaboration with Strategic Marketing team members, cross-functional AFSVC partners, and contracted vendors to ensure alignment across digital, technical, and operational stakeholders.

Performs platform-level system administration for the enterprise CMS and related MarTech platforms, including user provisioning, role and permission assignment, workflow configuration, template and module setup, and management of platform settings that support business operations.

Conducts quality assurance testing, validates vendor releases, troubleshoots functional issues, and coordinates resolution with contracted developers. Implements and maintains digital analytics and tracking configurations to support measurement of customer behavior, digital conversion, and business unit performance.

Configures tagging, dashboards, and reporting tools; validates data accuracy; and provides insights to inform platform enhancements and marketing decision-making.

Owns and manages the security and compliance documentation required for NAF-funded digital platforms, ensuring all system information, technical artifacts, and supporting materials are developed, compiled, and submitted in coordination with technical and cybersecurity stakeholders.

Initiates required compliance actions, tracks progress, routes documentation through appropriate offices, resolves comments, and ensures packages move through the full review and approval lifecycle. Authorization decisions and cybersecurity authority remain with designated enterprise authorities.

Develops, drafts, and compiles documentation required to support digital operations, including governance guidance, platform change packages, technical requirements, SOW inputs, and compliance-related materials. Staff documents through appropriate offices and ensure timely routing, review, and resolution of comments.

Prepare decision briefs and recommendations for the Marketing Operations Branch Chief. Serves as the Product Owner for AFS MarTech platforms, defining the roadmap, requirements, and prioritization of enhancements that improve customer experience, increase digital conversion, and strengthen revenue performance across business units.

Identifies capability needs and modernization opportunities based on analytics, user feedback, and mission requirements. Maintains product backlogs, user stories, acceptance criteria, and release plans.

Develops and maintains digital governance, including publishing standards, access roles, workflow rules, content lifecycle requirements, and digital compliance practices. Provides guidance to installations and program offices on interpreting and applying governance standards.

Ensure platform requirements remain aligned with enterprise technical and security frameworks in coordination with technical stakeholders. Leads development of Statements of Work (SOWs), technical requirements, and evaluation criteria for MarTech services, and coordinates with Procurement teams for contract execution, renewals, and modifications.

Monitors vendor performance and ensures deliverables meet requirements and support revenue-producing operations. Designs the strategy and framework for the MarTech training program and partners with Marketing Training & Development Manager(s) and the Installation Support Liaison for delivery, onboarding, and field communications.

Ensure installations can effectively use digital platforms to promote programs, drive participation, and support business unit performance. Communicates platform changes, updates, and requirements across the AF MilMark Network.
